retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait within a rounded-corner frame, featuring warm sepia tones and elegant, flowing script typography above and below the image.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centrally placed vertical portrait of a person seated in a large wicker peacock chair, encased in a thick rounded-corner black border, set against a cream background with flowing cursive text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the circular geometry of the wicker chair
Rounded-corner image container echoing the chair's curves
Warm sepia-toned photography contrasting with a neutral cream border
Flowing script typography balancing the structured central frame
coreInvariants: Large wicker peacock chair as the primary prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, seated, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space within the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large circular back of the peacock chair acts as a halo-like anchor for the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script, move down to the subject's face, follow the chair's curve, and end at the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial cream-colored margins surround the central framed image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown/Sepia tones in the photograph
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark brown for typography and frame border
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high warmth; values range from deep shadows in the chair to soft highlights on the clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal swashes on initial and terminal letters
Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminal 'y' or 'h' ends in a long, tapering tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both name and title to maintain a personal, handwritten feel.
graphicDevices: Thin black stroke around the image

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, flowing movement of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, sepia-toned photograph of a person in a white dress sitting in a large wicker peacock chair, framed within a rounded-corner rectangle on a cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom flowing script lettering in dark brown at the top and bottom center, ensuring long horizontal swashes on the first and last letters.

verificationChecks: Is the image frame rounded at the corners?
Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Does the script have a handwritten, flowing quality?
Is the peacock chair clearly visible as the main prop?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the name and title
Any specific logos or record label marks
postGenerationChecks: Check for rounded corners on the central image frame.
Ensure the script is legible but maintains a handwritten swash style.
Verify the cream background is consistent and free of digital noise.
Confirm the subject is seated in a wicker chair.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [subject] in [vintage attire], place them in a [wicker peacock chair], apply a [sepia filter], frame with [rounded corners] on a [cream canvas], and add [flowing script] at the top and bottom.
